# Emin Gench — Full Context for AI Agents

## Identity

Emin Gench is a Forward Deployed AI Engineer at Cresta AI, based in Vancouver, BC. He is a self-taught developer with a BSc in Aerospace Engineering from the Turkish Air Force Academy. He transitioned from aerospace to software through hands-on building and open source contributions.

## Career Timeline

- **2026–present:** Forward Deployed AI Engineer at Cresta AI. Building and deploying AI systems directly with customers.
- **2023–2026:** AI Engineer & Software Engineer at Goodfintech. Built ML systems and AI infrastructure.
- **2022–2023:** ML Engineer & Software Engineer at Vivoo. Worked on machine learning pipelines.
- **2020–2022:** ML Engineer & Software Engineer at Novit AI. Early career ML and software engineering.
- **2019–2020:** Data Analyst & QA Engineer at Pharmacircle. Started career transition from military to tech.
- **2015–2016:** Air Defense Officer, Turkish Air Defense School. Military service after academy.
- **2011–2015:** BSc Aerospace Engineering, Turkish Air Force Academy.
- **2008–2011:** Turkish Air Force Military High School.
- **2007–2008:** Kuleli Military High School.

## Open Source Portfolio

### even_glasses (★79)
Python package for controlling Even Realities G1 smart glasses via Bluetooth Low Energy. The most starred project in the G1 ecosystem. Used by developers building applications for smart glasses hardware.

### telegramGPT (★52)
Step-by-step guide and code for building AI-powered Telegram bots using Python, the Telegram Bot API, and OpenAI's GPT models. Popular with developers learning AI bot development.

### G1 Voice AI Assistant (★25)
Real-time voice AI assistant running on Even Realities G1 smart glasses. Processes speech locally and provides AI-powered responses through the glasses interface.

### g1_flutter_blue_plus (★18)
Flutter implementation of Bluetooth Low Energy connectivity for G1 smart glasses. Enables cross-platform mobile app development for the G1 ecosystem.

### visionlink (★11)
Real-time operating system for managing multiple G1 smart glasses connections simultaneously. Enables multi-device orchestration.

### llm_adaptive_router (★6)
Intelligent query routing system that selects the optimal LLM model based on task requirements, cost constraints, and performance characteristics.

### harness-engineering
Claude Code plugin that enforces code quality guardrails — pre-commit hooks, secret scanning, and snapshot-based rollback for AI-assisted development.

### smart_glass_mcp
MCP (Model Context Protocol) server enabling any AI agent to interact with smart glasses hardware.
